title: Le Creuset / Cousances – Doufeu Cast Iron Cocotte
description:
Beautiful vintage Doufeu cocotte in enameled cast iron by Cousances, the prestigious high-end heritage line of Le Creuset, made in France. A large-format and highly functional piece, combining traditional craftsmanship with innovative French culinary design.
This model is known for its unique condensation lid system: the hollow lid is designed to retain moisture during cooking. It can also hold ice cubes to create a thermal shock, encouraging continuous condensation. This process naturally bastes the food, enhancing tenderness and intensifying flavors.
The enameled cast iron ensures gentle, even, and energy-efficient cooking, preserving the natural taste and texture of ingredients. A method widely appreciated by professional chefs for its ability to produce melt-in-the-mouth results.
Fully compatible with all heat sources, including induction, this cocotte is both practical and highly durable. Its large size makes it ideal for family meals and slow-cooked dishes.
Brand: Cousances (Le Creuset)
Model: Doufeu cocotte
Material: enameled cast iron
Dimensions: 33 × 25 cm
Features: condensation lid system (Doufeu technology)
Compatibility: all hobs, including induction
Origin: Made in France
Condition: vintage, good condition (see photos, part of the description)
This piece is often passed down through generations due to its exceptional cooking performance and long-lasting quality, making it both a functional kitchen tool and a piece of French culinary heritage.
